transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Nice to meet you too. Um, well, what brought me in is... I keep hearing a man’s voice. 

I hear it at work mostly, coming from the garage vents, and sometimes right from under the hood of the cars I'm working on. It sounds as clear as somebody standing right next to me. He just keeps telling me not to trust my husband, and... and telling me not to touch certain cars in the shop. It's just getting really hard to deal with, so I figured I needed to come in and see someone.
Do you ever hear this man’s voice when you’re not at work?
No, um... not really. It's pretty much just at the shop. Once I clock out and go home, I don't hear him anymore. It really only happens when I'm around the garage or working on the cars there.
When you hear this man's voice at work, does it seem like it's coming from outside you, as if someone or something in the garage is actually speaking?

Yeah, exactly. Like I was saying a minute ago, it definitely sounds like it's coming from outside of me. It's not just a thought in my head. I physically hear it coming right out of the garage vents, or... or straight from under the hood of the car. It sounds exactly like a real person is standing right next to me speaking out loud.
Have you used any drugs or substances around the times when you hear the voice at work?

No, um... no, I haven't. I don't do any drugs or anything like that. I definitely wouldn't be messing with any substances while I'm on the clock working on people's cars. I'm completely sober when this happens.
Do you get headaches while you're at the garage?
No, I don't really get headaches. Sometimes my neck gets a little stiff from looking up at the undercarriage all day, but my head feels fine.
Do you believe your husband is actually untrustworthy?

Yes, I do. I know it probably sounds far-fetched to anyone else, but... I’m still convinced that my husband and the shop owner are working together to track what I’m doing. They've been using the EV chargers at work and the security cameras to watch me. They try to deny it, and they'll even show me the camera footage and say there’s nothing there, but... I just know they're monitoring me.
Have these experiences caused you to have trouble functioning at work or at home?

Yes, it's... it's definitely causing problems. At the shop, I've been making mistakes because I'm so distracted by everything going on. They actually pulled me off the high-voltage EV work because my supervisor said people were worried I wasn't being safe. And at home... things are really bad. The fighting with my husband got so intense over all of this that he actually took me in for an emergency evaluation. So, yeah, it's affecting pretty much everything.
How long have you been hearing the man's voice?
It's been about ten months. The voice, and... well, the whole thing with them tracking me, it's all been happening for about ten months now.
During these last ten months, have you had a period where you felt unusually energetic and needed much less sleep than usual?

Yeah, I have. There were periods... well, for weeks at a time, I'd sleep maybe two or three hours a night. I would wake up way before dawn, and my mind was already right back in the garage. I just felt so energetic that laying there trying to sleep more felt like it would just waste time.
During those times when you only slept two or three hours, did you also feel unusually happy or euphoric?

Yeah, I guess you could say that. I'll feel like I'm just... flying high, you know? Like I have the energy and the know-how to fix every single car in town. But it can switch pretty fast. Like, if I'm feeling that good and my husband asks why the dishes aren't done, or one of the other techs moves my socket set at the shop... I just blow up. I get so angry, like they're trying to hold me back or slow me down when I'm on a roll.
Have there been times when the voice or the feeling that you were being tracked continued even when your mood felt normal?

Yeah, actually. Um, there was a stretch... maybe a few weeks where things felt a lot more normal. I was sleeping a regular amount, and I wasn't rushing around trying to do a million things at once. But even then, during that quieter time, I still heard the man's voice in the garage. And I still knew, I mean, I still believed that my husband and my boss were keeping tabs on me and tracking what I was doing. So, yeah, it didn't stop just because my mood settled down.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

No, I haven't really had anything like that. I mean, I get frustrated or angry sometimes, like I mentioned before, but I don't really get down or sad. Definitely not for two weeks straight. I just haven't felt that way.
Over these ten months, have the times when your mood was unusually high or irritable made up most of the time you’ve been ill?

Yeah, I'd say so. Most of this past year, honestly, has been taken over by those stretches. The times where I'm just full of energy, talking too fast, taking on way too much at the shop... I just feel driven, like I can't slow down no matter what. So, yeah, that's been the majority of the time.
